reviewItem.question: Does "Feature Flag Promotions / Deprecations: cert-manager's feature flags allow for easier testing and adoption of new features with a reduced risk of breaking…" mean a change to feature-gate:cert-manager|name=ValidateCAA (deprecated)?

proposed.statement: cert-manager v1.17 deprecates the ValidateCAA feature gate, which validates the CAA DNS record during ACME issuance; it still works in v1.17 but will be removed entirely in cert-manager v1.18.0.
